min_button.what: Collapses the window to its title bar, click again to bring it back.
examples: Minimize the tool while you work in the viewport.
Keep Helpers minimized on a second monitor and open it only when needed.
min_button.details: Hides the tool body and shrinks the window; clicking again restores the saved size.

max_button.what: Switches the window between its normal size and full screen.
examples: Make the AutoRigger big to see more blocks at once.
Go full size on Helpers to see every tab button at once.
max_button.details: showMaximized() / normal state. A right double click on the title bar does the same.

close_button.what: Closes this tool window. Nothing in the scene changes.
examples: Click X when you are done with the tool.
Close and reopen a tool after editing its code to load the changes.
